scope: Owner-only, explicit fixed revisions, opt-in lexical index/search; bounded C1 roots and existing R1 passages; Elasticsearch only; no models.

client_schema.envelope: Offline operation/path/body wrapper; HTTP uses path parameters and body directly.

encoding.output: 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters, no prefix
encoding.unicode: Reject unpaired surrogates; no Unicode/newline normalization, trim or BOM.

identity.restriction: First slice: exactly one member, row_role=chunk, physical_parent=null; no semantic node IDs generated.
unit_policies: Use exact existing passage; do not resplit
Use exact entire root; oversize rejected

aggregate_profile.rule: Public profile_sha256 is the aggregate; each source binding uses the selected unit-strategy chunk_plan_sha256.

identity.dataset_language_rule: Bind the current trusted raw dataset.language UTF8 string, including empty native default; do not normalize it to English for hashing.
identity.tokenizer_rule: Bind trusted actual tokenizer producer SHA from the implementation; all sample producer hashes below are synthetic placeholders.

persistence.reference_payload: Exact compact knowledge_ref shape shown in vectors; coordinates are fixed source_utf8 in this first slice, no output_range or per-member coordinate extensions.
persistence.reference_encoding: Stable DTO JSON string in _source; strict decode; never client metadata. Row manifests bind actual persisted reference bytes, content hash/length and fixed member.
persistence.availability: New knowledge rows remain exactly zero before and after publication; native generic zero filtering is lt1 and requires a trusted exact term0 query adaptation.
persistence.publication: After all batch rows, refresh and complete row/reference/content verification, CAS SQL publication under current policies/lifecycle. No cross-store transaction is claimed.
persistence.writes: New protocol uses create-only rows and manifest-equivalent conflict replay. Preserve old ingestion/update guards; ordinary status/upsert/update must not overwrite or activate these rows.
persistence.retrieval: Reuse RetrievalService.Search query construction and engine lexical ordering with embedding=nil, model augmentation disabled, exact domain/binding/allowed-row constraints and trusted field projection; no auto-parent expansion.

opaque_server_values.index_ref: SQL publication batch identity and manifest digest, not an ES index name or credential.
opaque_server_values.selection_sha256: Server digest of normalized fixed target tuples, one revision per source; exact stored definition and idempotency required in implementation.
opaque_server_values.manifest_sha256: Digest of the immutable, serialized server publication manifest; the stored bytes and row entries are authoritative, not client samples.
